what: Earlier internal measurements (October 2026) of the Ideogram 4 LoRA engine (perf_kit/dit/ideogram4) against LogoLabs' reference trainer, on a PRIVATE image dataset; reported for context, not reproducible from this repository (neither the data nor the reference trainer is public). Source: research notes 2026-10-31 (and 2026-10-10 / 10-11 for the reference trainer's own earlier fixes).
model: Ideogram 4 (9.3B DiT, FP8 checkpoint ideogram-ai/ideogram-4-fp8), LoRA on attention.qkv / attention.o / feed_forward.w1-3 (rsLoRA r32, 3 timestep-binned adapters, as in the production run)
data: private: a LogoLabs image + caption dataset (147,322 images, structured JSON captions); the 1-GPU bench uses its 1024 x 1024 bucket
gpu: NVIDIA GH200 120GB, 660 W module power cap
mfu_convention: the reference trainer's useful-FLOP count from torch's FLOP counter, 95.16 TFLOP per 1024 x 448 sample (pilot job 4686550) = 207.4 MFLOP per image pixel, used for every row; 989 TFLOPS bf16 peak; recompute not counted
reference: LogoLabs' reference trainer with its own October fixes on (flash-attention 3 varlen, caption-only text encoding, activation-checkpoint budget of 90k tokens): LoRA modules under bf16 autocast, autograd backward

micro_batch_1gpu.what: seconds per 4-sample micro-batch (~18.3k packed tokens), one GH200, real weights, the same batches for every arm
notes: mfu_derived = the reference's 21.5% x 4.09 s / s (same useful FLOPs); the other MFUs are as logged
--compile measured 2.83 s in 4688444 while another arm shared the GPU, 2.58 s with the GPU to itself (4688622)
text encoder 0.14 s + VAE 0.13 s of each micro-batch (4688622)

ab_1node.what: training A/B, 1 node x 4 GH200, 4 images x 2 accumulation x 4 GPUs = 32 per step, the same batches, timesteps and noise, 150 steps; median s/step over windows 30-150 including validation and sample sheets
ab_1node.parity: per-rank 10-step window losses equal to the 3rd decimal at all 15 windows; validation loss at fixed t 0.3-0.9 equal to <= 1e-4 at steps 50 / 100 / 150; t 0.1 within its own check-to-check spread

ab_2node.what: 2 nodes x 4 GH200, the production run's layout and arguments, global batch 32, steps 40-60

production.what: the production run continued on the engine (--compile --triton_swiglu), 2 nodes

gradient_parity.reading: one 1024 x 1024 micro-batch: the engine differs from the reference by as much as the reference differs from itself under a different attention kernel (bf16 rounding floor)

fp8_forward.verdict: rejected: no speed-up, 10x the rounding floor

reference_trainer_october_fixes.what: context: the reference trainer's own step-time fixes before the engine existed (internal, 2026-10-10 / 10-11)
